note.en: Monthly physics and society research bonus; empires without the Jump Drive also get 50% progress on that tech.

notes.zh: 审阅注：首次进入标有 guardians_horror_system 的星系时，隐藏事件 3000（on_entering_system_first_time，00_on_actions.txt:911）生成位面梦魇（初始被瘫痪，8天后由隐藏 3220 解除）并向进入者发出本通知。
notes.en: Review note: on first entering a guardians_horror_system, hidden 3000 (on_entering_system_first_time, 00_on_actions.txt:911) spawns the Dimensional Horror (disabled at first; hidden 3220 enables it 8 days later) and sends this notice (leviathans_events_2.txt:3909-4002).

notes.zh: 审阅注：击杀者另会在尚无 horrific_celebration 标记且拥有行星时开启庆典情境（见庆典故事；其中恐怖负相物质路线与此相关）。
notes.en: Review note: if the killer owns planets and lacks the flag horrific_celebration it also starts the celebration situation (see that story; its Horrific Inverse Mass branch belongs here).
